overview: You let the Prince come into the square and gave him no speech. The friend is already off the page. Phillips is not on the leaf, and you did not tell him.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the entrance, and stopped before a speech.

parties.name: Augustine Phillips
parties.context: Not on the leaf, and not told.
